mapper.select:
WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO payment_refund_record ( refund_no, order_no, user_id, payment_provider, external_trade_no, payment_callback_id, paid_amount_yuan, refund_amount_yuan, currency, status, source, reason_code, reason_detail, order_status_when_detected, detected_at, detection_batch_no, user_message, snapshot_json, extra_json, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{refundNo}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{paymentProvider}, #{externalTradeNo}, #{paymentCallbackId}, #{paidAmountYuan}, #{refundAmountYuan}, #{currency}, 'REFUND_PENDING', #{source}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonDetail}, #{orderStatusWhenDetected}, #{detectedAt}, #{detectionBatchNo}, #{userMessage}, CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{extraJson} AS jsonb), #{idempotencyKey}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING * )
SELECT FROM inserted UNION ALL SELECT FROM payment_refund_record WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) LIMIT 1

WITH raw AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER () AS rn, callback_no, refund_no, order_no, user_id, payment_provider, external_trade_no, payment_callback_id, paid_amount_yuan, refund_amount_yuan, currency, source, reason_code, reason_detail, order_status_when_detected, detected_at_epoch_ms, detection_batch_no, user_message, snapshot_json, extra_json, idempotency_key FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{refundsJson} AS jsonb)) AS refund( callback_no text, refund_no text, order_no text, user_id bigint, payment_provider text, external_trade_no text, payment_callback_id text, paid_amount_yuan numeric, refund_amount_yuan numeric, currency text, source text, reason_code text, reason_detail text, order_status_when_detected text, detected_at_epoch_ms bigint, detection_batch_no text, user_message text, snapshot_json text, extra_json text, idempotency_key text ) ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO payment_refund_record ( refund_no, order_no, user_id, payment_provider, external_trade_no, payment_callback_id, paid_amount_yuan, refund_amount_yuan, currency, status, source, reason_code, reason_detail, order_status_when_detected, detected_at, detection_batch_no, user_message, snapshot_json, extra_json, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT refund_no, order_no, user_id, payment_provider, external_trade_no, payment_callback_id, paid_amount_yuan, refund_amount_yuan, currency, 'REFUND_PENDING', source, reason_code, reason_detail, order_status_when_detected, to_timestamp(detected_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0), detection_batch_no, user_message, CAST(snapshot_json AS jsonb), CAST(extra_json AS jsonb), idempotency_key, NOW(), NOW() FROM raw ORDER BY rn ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING * ), refund_rows AS ( SELECT raw.rn, raw.callback_no, inserted.* FROM raw INNER JOIN inserted ON inserted.idempotency_key = raw.idempotency_key UNION ALL SELECT raw.rn, raw.callback_no, r.* FROM raw INNER JOIN payment_refund_record r ON r.idempotency_key = raw.idempotency_key WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inserted WHERE inserted.idempotency_key = raw.idempotency_key ) )
SELECT refund_rows.callback_no AS "callbackNo", refund_rows.id, refund_rows.refund_no AS "refundNo", refund_rows.order_no AS "orderNo", refund_rows.user_id AS "userId", refund_rows.payment_provider AS "paymentProvider", refund_rows.external_trade_no AS "externalTradeNo", refund_rows.external_refund_no AS "externalRefundNo", refund_rows.payment_callback_id AS "paymentCallbackId", refund_rows.paid_amount_yuan AS "paidAmountYuan", refund_rows.refund_amount_yuan AS "refundAmountYuan", refund_rows.currency, refund_rows.status, refund_rows.source, refund_rows.reason_code AS "reasonCode", refund_rows.reason_detail AS "reasonDetail", refund_rows.order_status_when_detected AS "orderStatusWhenDetected", refund_rows.detected_at AS "detectedAt", refund_rows.detection_batch_no AS "detectionBatchNo", refund_rows.version, refund_rows.created_at AS "createdAt", refund_rows.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM refund_rows ORDER BY refund_rows.rn

SELECT FROM payment_refund_record
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE payment_refund_record SET status = 'REFUND_APPROVED', approved_admin_id = #{adminId}, approved_at = NOW(), admin_remark = #{adminRemark}, user_message = COALESCE(#{userMessage}, user_message), updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND status = 'REFUND_PENDING' AND version = #{version} RETURNING * )
SELECT FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE payment_refund_record SET status = 'REFUND_REJECTED', rejected_admin_id = #{adminId}, rejected_at = NOW(), reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, admin_remark = #{adminRemark}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND status = 'REFUND_PENDING' AND version = #{version} RETURNING * )
SELECT FROM updated

WITH updated AS ( UPDATE payment_refund_record SET status = 'REFUNDED', refunded_admin_id = #{adminId}, refunded_at = NOW(), refund_proof_no = #{refundProofNo}, refund_proof_url = #{refundProofUrl}, admin_remark = #{adminRemark}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND status IN ('REFUND_PENDING', 'REFUND_APPROVED', 'REFUND_FAILED') AND version = #{version} RETURNING * )
SELECT FROM updated

WITH picked AS ( SELECT id FROM payment_refund_record WHERE ( status = 'REFUND_PENDING' OR ( status = 'REFUND_FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ) ) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), updated AS ( UPDATE payment_refund_record r SET status = 'REFUNDING', refund_started_at = COALESCE(refund_started_at, NOW()), last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = r.version + 1 FROM picked WHERE r.id = picked.id RETURNING r.* )
SELECT FROM updated

WITH raw AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER () AS rn, stream_message_id, refund_no FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{refundsJson} AS jsonb)) AS refund( stream_message_id text, refund_no text ) ), deduped AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (refund_no) * FROM raw WHERE refund_no IS NOT NULL AND refund_no <> '' ORDER BY refund_no, rn ), picked AS ( SELECT r.id FROM payment_refund_record r INNER JOIN deduped d ON d.refund_no = r.refund_no WHERE ( r.status = 'REFUND_PENDING' OR ( r.status = 'REFUND_FAILED' AND r.retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND (r.next_retry_at IS NULL OR r.next_retry_at <= NOW()) ) OR ( r.status = 'REFUNDING' AND r.updated_at <= NOW() - (#{processingTimeoutMs} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') ) ) ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), updated AS ( UPDATE payment_refund_record r SET status = 'REFUNDING', refund_started_at = COALESCE(refund_started_at, NOW()), last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = r.version + 1 FROM picked WHERE r.id = picked.id RETURNING r.* ), stream_rows AS ( SELECT raw.stream_message_id, raw.rn, FALSE AS stream_ack_only, updated.* FROM raw INNER JOIN updated ON updated.refund_no = raw.refund_no UNION ALL SELECT raw.stream_message_id, raw.rn, TRUE AS stream_ack_only, r.* FROM raw INNER JOIN payment_refund_record r ON r.refund_no = raw.refund_no WHERE r.status IN ('REFUNDED', 'REFUND_REJECTED', 'REFUND_CANCELLED') OR (r.status = 'REFUND_FAILED' AND r.retry_count >= #{maxRetry}) )
SELECT stream_message_id AS "streamMessageId", stream_ack_only AS "streamAckOnly", (NOT stream_ack_only) AS "streamClaimed", id, refund_no AS "refundNo", order_no AS "orderNo", user_id AS "userId", payment_provider AS "paymentProvider", external_trade_no AS "externalTradeNo", external_refund_no AS "externalRefundNo", payment_callback_id AS "paymentCallbackId", paid_amount_yuan AS "paidAmountYuan", refund_amount_yuan AS "refundAmountYuan", currency, status, source, reason_code AS "reasonCode", reason_detail AS "reasonDetail", order_status_when_detected AS "orderStatusWhenDetected", detected_at AS "detectedAt", detection_batch_no AS "detectionBatchNo", approved_admin_id AS "approvedAdminId", approved_at AS "approvedAt", rejected_admin_id AS "rejectedAdminId", rejected_at AS "rejectedAt", reject_reason AS "rejectReason", refunded_admin_id AS "refundedAdminId", refunded_at AS "refundedAt", refund_started_at AS "refundStartedAt", retry_count AS "retryCount", next_retry_at AS "nextRetryAt", last_error_code AS "lastErrorCode", last_error_message AS "lastErrorMessage", refund_proof_no AS "refundProofNo", refund_proof_url AS "refundProofUrl", admin_remark AS "adminRemark", user_message AS "userMessage", snapshot_json::text AS "snapshotJson", extra_json::text AS "extraJson", idempotency_key AS "idempotencyKey", version, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM stream_rows ORDER BY rn
mapper.update: WITH result_rows AS ( SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{resultsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( refund_no text, status text, external_refund_no text, last_error_code text, last_error_message text, retry_count integer, next_retry_at_epoch_ms bigint, refunded_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ) UPDATE payment_refund_record r SET status = result_rows.status, external_refund_no = result_rows.external_refund_no, last_error_code = result_rows.last_error_code, last_error_message = result_rows.last_error_message, retry_count = GREATEST(result_rows.retry_count, r.retry_count), next_retry_at = CASE WHEN result_rows.next_retry_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(result_rows.next_retry_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, refunded_at = CASE WHEN result_rows.refunded_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN r.refunded_at ELSE to_timestamp(result_rows.refunded_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, updated_at = NOW(), version = r.version + 1 FROM result_rows WHERE r.refund_no = result_rows.refund_no AND r.status = 'REFUNDING'
